title: Missing moeb tool: Read (external file reader for exact byte inspection)
description: Used the external Read tool to inspect exact byte content of .moeb/README.md to diagnose repeated patch_file failures. No moeb tool provides byte-level inspection beyond read_file (too large for context) and read_file_range (may normalize content).
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb tool for byte-level file inspection with line-range and exact-output support.
resolution_summary: Superseded by consolidated signal a1000056: read_file and read_file_range cover in-project reads; absolute-path gap tracked separately.
